verdict.rationale: AutoGen ships a UserProxyAgent that lets a human inject feedback into agent conversations, providing a human-in-the-loop mechanism, but the evidence never shows a mechanism to gate specific sensitive tool calls for approval before execution (e.g., per-tool approval hooks). Missing for 10: explicit tool-call-level approval/interrupt API, documentation of selective tool gating, and independent confirmation it works as an approval gate rather than general chat feedback.
